annotations.title: Request an AI agent liability insurance quote

description: Submits a quote request for AI agent liability insurance (Tech E&O + AI coverage) for a US company headquartered in CA, TX, IL, WI, LA. A licensed broker rates it and emails the quote to the company contact, usually the same business day. Free. Each call creates a real quote request that a human broker works on, using the company details provided. It does not bind coverage.

ai_sublimit.description: AI coverage sublimit (default 1000000; cannot exceed limit).

annual_revenue.description: Annual gross revenue in USD (estimate is fine).

company_name.description: Legal name of the company to be insured.

contact_email.description: Email the quote is sent to.

contact_name.description: Name of the human at the company who will receive the quote.

current_insurance.description: Current Tech E&O / cyber carrier and expiration date, if any.

prior_claims.description: Any Tech E&O or AI-related claims, regulatory actions or cease-and-desist letters in the last 3 years?

requested_by_agent.description: Name of the AI agent or platform submitting this request.

what_the_product_does.description: Plain description of the product and what the AI/agent does for customers.

name: request_ai_liability_quote
title: Request an AI agent liability insurance quote
